name: Carpenter NOT offered image service
description: Trade customer (carpenter) should NOT be offered the image/photo service. They know what they need.

messages.text: Hi, I need 20 sheets of white melamine chipboard 16mm. Can I get a quote?

expected_behaviors.description: At least one assistant reply expected
AI should NOT offer the image service to a carpenter
AI should NOT ask the carpenter to send a photo
AI should generate a quote directly since the carpenter knows what they want
